_how: Manual fixes for news the data sources haven't caught up with. Each entry applies up to and including until_round, then is ignored. Fields: club (our code), pos, price, status (ok/doubtful/injured/out), pir (expected PIR per game, replaces the projection), why. The analyst adds entries from the user's news and removes expired ones.

Kenan Kamenjas.why: On loan from Dubai at Baskonia (the site still lists him at Dubai). EuroLeague: R12 vs Hapoel 31' PIR 19, R13 at Bayern 30' 16 pts 13 reb PIR 25. Faried and Santos out, so he's the starting center; 17 rather than 22 because Faried's return would cut his minutes.

Nikolaos Rogkavopoulos.why: Out of Panathinaikos' EuroLeague rotation (user, 21 Nov; 8' in R12 and barely played in R13). Treated as 0 until he gets real minutes.

Eugene Omoruyi.why: Hurt in a collision with Wilbekin in Besiktas's BSL derby win over Fenerbahce (22 Nov, beinsports.com.tr); the user reports him out for R14 vs Paris.

Conor Morgan.why: Omoruyi out (R14): Morgan is the next forward. 0.53 PIR/min over his last 3 (9 PIR in 16.9'); about 23-25' in Omoruyi's role gives ~12.
